title: Genesis 4:9 — “The keeper of my brother am I?”
summary: Genesis 4:9 in English and Hebrew, now with Cain’s reply translated literally from the Hebrew word order: “The keeper of my brother am I?” The extra question at the bottom is gone.

text.text: 9 And the LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel your brother?” And he said, “I do not know. The keeper of my brother am I?”
9 ויאמר יהוה אל קין אי הבל אחיך ויאמר לא ידעתי השמר אחי אנכי׃

keywords: the keeper of my brother am I
uncertain: The LORD in English and יהוה in Hebrew have individually coloured letters (decorative: red L/yod, orange R/vav), meaning not explained on this slide.
